g.text: Native profile context across the sampled change in organization
Largest original size per model; common f=0.01,0.03,0.1. First saved seed per condition, at fixed native midwindow time.
Profiles remain unshifted and keep actual native amplitudes. Independent paths across strengths; these snapshots are not occupancy estimates.
The chosen strengths bracket observed occupancy changes on the finite grid; they are not phase boundaries. Actual sampled region counts are printed in each legend.
Goryachev’s large-cell high-input profiles have little contrast relative to basal; half-current-contrast regions may still be counted. Native-scale enlargement preserves that distinction.
Spring uses fixed material coordinates and records the actual C(t) for physical M₀/M₁. The original 0.01 level has12 seeds; 0.03/0.1 currently have2. No peak normalization.
